official.deadline_central_display: 28 February 2026 (for Masters starting 14 September 2026, as published on the official page)
official.deadline_note: The application is made online from the beginning of January of each year, and applicants receive an e-mail with a personal link to the form only after registering. The Faculty's page does not yet publish a date for the round after 28 February 2026.
official.application_cycle: Annual round opening at the beginning of January, with a 28 February deadline
official.status_note: The Faculty states that the application is made online from the beginning of January of each year and that the next application deadline published on the page is 28 February 2026, for Masters starting 14 September 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Faculty describes the Excellence Fellowship as a grant with no teaching duties; it does not state that the grant pays tuition. Master's programmes at the Faculty are either entirely in English or in English and French.
benefits: A grant amounting to CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year with no teaching duties
Awarded for one year and extended for the regular duration of the chosen Master's programme, three or four semesters, if the holder is academically successful at the end of the first semester
Some fellowships are financed by external partners, including the Werner Foundation and a private foundation in Geneva

Must meet the admission criteria of the chosen Master programme at the UNIGE Faculty of Science
Must not already have started a Master programme at the Faculty of Science
Candidate selection is based on excellence

Submit the application in English or French as a SINGLE pdf file
All listed clauses must be completed or the file will not be considered
Provide proof of enrolment: a scan of the UNIGE card, or the e-mail entitled 'UNIGE-Candidature: Depot de votre dossier' if not yet enrolled

selection_criteria: Candidate selection is based on excellence
Selection is made by the Grant Committee of the Faculty of Science
coverage: A grant of CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year
No teaching duties attached to the fellowship
Extension for the regular duration of the Master's programme conditional on academic success after the first semester

Wait for the e-mail from the beginning of January containing a personal link to the application form

official.application_route: Register for the chosen Master's at UNIGE, wait for the personal link e-mailed from the beginning of January, then complete the online form and upload a single PDF with every document.
official.citizenship_residency: Open regardless of home university or country of residence.
official.international_eligibility: Open to students from any university worldwide; the 2026 winners list includes candidates from Argentina, Cuba, Estonia, Hungary, India, Iran, Italy, Mexico, Poland, Serbia, Switzerland and the United States.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Restricted to Master of Science programmes in the Faculty of Science disciplines: astronomy, biology, chemistry and biochemistry, computer science, mathematics, physics, pharmaceutical sciences, and earth sciences.
official.research_requirement: The motivation letter must describe the applicant's specific scientific interests and motivation to pursue a Master of Science programme at the University of Geneva.
official.duration: One year, extended for the regular duration of the chosen Master's programme, three or four semesters, if academically successful at the end of the first semester
official.description: The Faculty of Science of the University of Geneva, with the support of external partners, runs an Excellence Fellowship programme for outstanding and highly motivated students who wish to pursue a Master of Science degree in one of the disciplines covered by the Faculty.
official.program_type: Faculty-level excellence grant scheme for incoming Master of Science students
official.english_requirement: No separate English test is mandated for the fellowship. Master's programmes are either entirely in English or in English and French, and TOEFL or other language test results may be included as pertinent information in the file.

applicant_utility.summary: The Faculty publishes this as a range, CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year, with no teaching duties, so treat the top of the range as an aspiration rather than an entitlement and plan living costs independently. The unusual trap is sequencing: you cannot apply until you have begun the UNIGE enrolment procedure for your chosen Master's, because the Faculty requires a scan of your UNIGE card or the 'UNIGE-Candidature: Depot de votre dossier' confirmation e-mail as proof, and the application link itself only arrives by e-mail from the beginning of January. The renewal is genuinely valuable, since the award runs a full year and then extends across the whole three or four semester programme provided you are academically successful at the end of the first semester. Twenty-one candidates were funded in the 2026 round across nine disciplines, most supported by a private Geneva foundation plus one Werner Foundation fellowship, so think of this as a small, discipline-specific award rather than a broad faculty-wide pot.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-ranked students in astronomy, biology, chemistry and biochemistry, computer science, mathematics, physics, pharmaceutical sciences or earth sciences who have already started enrolling in a UNIGE Master's.
application_readiness_checklist: Start the UNIGE enrolment procedure for your chosen Master's first, since proof of registration is a required document and the application link is only sent after registering
Merge every document into a single PDF before uploading, since the Faculty specifies a SINGLE pdf file
Keep the CV to two pages maximum, which the Faculty states explicitly
Ask two professors well in advance, since both reference letters must sit inside the same single PDF
Write the motivation letter around your specific scientific interests rather than general motivation, which is what the Faculty asks for
common_rejection_risks: Having already started a Master programme at the Faculty of Science, which permanently rules out an application
Submitting a file with any clause incomplete, which the Faculty states will not be considered
Uploading several separate PDFs instead of one combined file
Applying before beginning the UNIGE enrolment procedure, leaving no proof of registration to attach
Assuming the grant covers tuition or living costs, which the page does not state
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, travel and any tuition are not stated to be covered; the CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 annual grant is a stipend-style award with no teaching duties attached, so you must fund your own cost of living in Geneva.
document_audit: Proof of enrolment takes one of two exact forms depending on status: a scan of the UNIGE card for current students, or the 'UNIGE-Candidature: Depot de votre dossier' e-mail for those still registering
The transcript must cover exams passed during the bachelor education with all grades, not a summary or a degree certificate
Reference letters must come from professors and attest aptitude specifically for the chosen programme
The application may be written in English or French, so a bilingual file is acceptable but mixed-language documents should be kept readable
alerts: The next published deadline of 28 February 2026 has passed relative to the Faculty's own page, and no replacement date is published yet; because applications open at the beginning of January each year, watch for the personal link e-mail in early January
The application link is personal and arrives by e-mail, so make sure the address you register with is one you monitor
Not every fellowship is funded by the Faculty itself: some are financed by external partners such as the Werner Foundation and a private Geneva foundation, and the criteria attached can differ
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Enrol at UNIGE for the chosen Master's, receive the personal application link by e-mail from the beginning of January, complete the online form, and upload a single combined PDF before the 28 February deadline; the Grant Committee of the Faculty of Science then selects on excellence.
